title: assistente social
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.
A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.
A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.
Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.
Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Acolher os usuários e humanizar a atenção identificando vulnerabilidades sociais e fornecendo suporte psicossocial as famílias.
Desenvolver ações intersetoriais, mantendo a integração com a rede de suporte social, fortalecendo e implementando as ações na comunidade;
Realizar ações preventivas e promocionais junto aos grupos programáticos desenvolvidos pelas equipes da ESF;
Realizar atendimentos e visitas domiciliares compartilhados com profissionais das equipes ESF e NASF identificando situações de vulnerabilidade social ou negligência e fortalecer a rede de apoio da criança ou adolescente.
Realizar atendimentos específicos da sua área de atuação, quando necessário, executando o levantamento das condições de vida da criança/adolescente para auxiliar na equipe multidisciplinar.
Realizar a articulação com a rede mediando o acesso a políticas públicas de saúde, assistência, educação, lazer e cultura, assegurando direitos previstos em lei.
Garantir a qualidade do registro das atividades nos sistemas nacionais de informação na Atenção Especializada.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Serviço Social
Pós-Graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Políticas Públicas, Estratégia Saúde da Família, Saúde Pública ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Assistente Social em Equipe Multidisciplinar ou Projetos Sociais.
Informações adicionais
Carga Horária: 30h semanais
Local de trabalho: Irajá
Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Assistant Cargo Supervisor
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Background

  • 5 Communicate effectively.

Offshore - Perform Lifeboat Maintenance Offshore - Manage Supply and Crew Boat Operations Offshore - Monitor Weather Condition Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge Offshore - Crane operations, rigging and lifting operations Offshore - Safety Management - HOD Offshore - Define Hull Integrity Management Offshore - Tanker Terminal Offshore - Manage Cargo Export

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process.  This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts.  The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts.  The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes.  The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area. 
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector 
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector 
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes

Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We're at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Enfermeiro(a) | Belo Horizonte - MG
description:
O Leviva Belo Horizonte é um Centro de Cuidado Diário em saúde mental, um conceito ViV, que oferece atendimento especializado para pessoas com transtornos psiquiátricos e necessidades de reabilitação psicossocial.
Localizado no bairro Santo Antônio, a unidade une a praticidade da vida urbana com estrutura moderna e acolhedora, pensada para garantir conforto, discrição e bem-estar aos pacientes.
Com serviços que vão do Pronto Atendimento Psiquiátrico ao Centro de Cuidado Diário, oferecemos soluções completas para o cuidado contínuo em saúde mental — proporcionando mais tranquilidade para os pacientes e suas famílias.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Coordenar e orientar a equipe de profissionais de enfermagem quanto as rotinas e procedimentos da instituição;
Atuar junto às equipes multidisciplinares na área da saúde;
Prestar assistência/serviços de enfermagem junto aos pacientes;
Atender familiares em suas dúvidas e angústias tanto para clientes internados como clientes externos, prestando as orientações que se fazem necessárias;
Encaminhar demandas da equipe interna junto ao administrativo da instituição;
Representar a recepção de pacientes no período noturno e seguir procedimentos administrativos;
Atender todas as intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas dos clientes internados;
Planejar ações de enfermagem;
Implementar ações que promovam a saúde dos pacientes;
Promover a saúde bem como, orientar junto aos familiares, o quadro em que se encontram os pacientes;
Auditar serviços de enfermagem.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
Formação em Enfermagem com COREN ativo.
Experiência em Saúde Mental será um diferencial;
Empatia, e boa comunicação;
Informações adicionais
Sobre o processo seletivo:
Aqui na ViV, acreditamos que cada pessoa carrega uma história única, e queremos conhecer a sua. Nosso processo seletivo começa já no cadastro, como um convite para entendermos melhor sua trajetória, sua essência e sua conexão com a nossa cultura.
Na etapa seguinte, nosso time de Gente & Gestão entra em contato para uma conversa leve e acolhedora. Esse é um momento de troca: vamos falar sobre suas experiências, expectativas e o perfil da vaga, além de apresentar a ViV, nossos valores e o caminho do processo. Fique à vontade para tirar suas dúvidas, esse espaço é todo seu.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na ViV :
Conheça a ViV: entenda nossa atuação na área da saúde, nosso propósito e a forma como cuidamos das pessoas todos os dias.
Acompanhe nossos canais oficiais e redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre nossa cultura, valores e o jeito ViV de trabalhar.
Reflita sobre sua trajetória: pense nas suas principais experiências, aprendizados e conquistas, e como elas se conectam com a vaga.
Durante as conversas, compartilhe suas vivências de forma genuína. Falamos sobre resultados, mas também valorizamos os desafios enfrentados e os aprendizados ao longo do caminho.
Dica ViV: seja você. Compartilhe suas conquistas, aprendizados e desafios da sua trajetória. Valorizamos a transparência, o desenvolvimento contínuo e relações construídas com cuidado.
Desejamos a você um processo leve e uma ótima experiência com a ViV

title: Country Manager – Brasil
description:
Country Manager


Location: Brazil | Energy Services Sector

The Opportunity


We are seeking a transformational Country Manager to lead and expand a well-established operation within the energy services sector in Brazil.

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth mandate.

The selected executive will take full ownership of the country P&L, drive operational excellence, strengthen culture, and lead the next phase of strategic expansion. The goal is clear: double revenue within three years while maintaining uncompromising safety and performance standards.

Key Responsibilities


Strategic & Business Leadership

  • Full P&L responsibility for the country operation.

  • Develop and execute a robust business plan to ensure sustainable growth, profitability, and market share expansion.

  • Continuously assess market dynamics, competitive landscape, and client needs to identify new business opportunities.

  • Act as the senior representative of the company with key clients, partners, regulators, and industry stakeholders.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead the HSE culture aligned with the highest industry standards.

  • Oversee multi-site operations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with operational excellence.

  • Implement global best practices adapted to local realities.

  • Drive process optimization, cost efficiency, and continuous innovation.

People & Culture Leadership

  • Develop and mentor high-performing teams.

  • Build a strong leadership pipeline and succession planning structure.

  • Strengthen a culture rooted in accountability, collaboration, and high performance.

  • Ensure transparent and strategic communication across all organizational levels.

Strategic Objectives

  • Double revenue within 3 years.

  • Expand market share through new contracts and strategic positioning.

  • Achieve operational excellence with a zero-incident mindset.

  • Strengthen regional leadership presence and stakeholder relationships.

  • Maximize the performance and development of the team.

Requisitos


Required Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas sector.

  • Proven track record in senior leadership roles with direct P&L ownership.

  • Experience managing complex, multidisciplinary teams in demanding environments.

Technical Expertise


Strong and proven experience in:

  • Oil & Gas Services

Education & Languages

  • Degree in Engineering (Petroleum, Mechanical, or related), Geosciences, Business Administration, or similar.

  • MBA or Executive Education is a strong plus.

  • Full fluency in English is mandatory (daily interaction with global stakeholders).

  • Portuguese fluency required not nationality.

Leadership Profile


We are looking for a leader who combines:

  • Strategic mindset with strong execution capability.

  • Commercial acumen and long-term vision.

  • Decisive leadership in ambiguous environments.

  • Inspirational leadership style with strong people development focus.

  • Ability to build strategic alliances in a matrix organization.

  • Results orientation with hands-on attitude.

  • Resilience under pressure.

  • Uncompromising integrity and ethical standards.

Benefícios


Compensation


Highly competitive executive package including:

  • Fixed monthly compensation aligned with senior market standards.

  • Short-Term Incentive (STI).

  • Long-Term Incentive (LTI) including equity participation.

  • Executive benefits package.

  • Company vehicle.

title: Senior Service Technician
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • In this position, the Service Technician will be responsible for carrying out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, working both at company facilities and at customer sites. In this role you will be responsible for performing service and maintenance on Turbochargers in Brazil.

  • The role provides specialized technical support, executing activities in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines — ensuring superior customer experience and operational excellence.

  • Service Delivery: Performs Service tasks like disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of different types of turbochargers, in accordance with work instructions, through the identification of technical problems, carrying out remote and in-person analyses at the Workshop and or in the field in various categories of vessels (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. In the field it means by performing installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements, among others, meeting customer expectations and pre-established internal procedures.

  • Customer Approach: Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing Service work according to customer order and expectation Creates and maintains a good relationship with customers and understands their needs Identifies new sales opportunities and communicates them internally. Execute the repair according to instructions from service coordination

  • Materials & Supply: Coordinates, prepares and ensures that all materials, parts and equipment are available and at the appropriate quality for Service activities.

  • Documents & Reports: Prepares all documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative Reports work done in a timely manner and follows up when needed. Perform maintenance inspections and reports on turbochargers, as well as perform investigation and prepare reports for breaking down situations. Clean up parts and take pictures and measurements as requested by maintenance tool and process.

  • Troubleshooting: Proactively identifies potential equipment failures and requests proactive corrective actions Troubleshoots equipment failure and makes recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future.

  • Operational Excellence Proactively identifies suggestions for product and quality improvement and communicates them further in the Accelleron organization Provides recommendations to management to improve operations and customer service.

  • Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Integrity: Applies safety rules and safe practices, environmental responsibilities as well as quality process. Reports unsafe practices and incidents.

Your background:

Education and Experience

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate);

  • Experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines and turbochargers (minimum 10 years), large combustion engines, and/or mechanical technologies related to the maritime segment;

  • Experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including the use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, etc;

  • Certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, and electric forklift, work at height, ensuring compliance with industrial safety standards;

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner etc.);

  • Portuguese as native language and Advanced English;

  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training;

  • Active driver's license;

  • Passport.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in working within regulations and rules, following management guidelines;

  • Service and solution-oriented mindset, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills;

  • Customer and results orientation;

  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety;

  • Effective communication and teamwork;

  • Proven capability to perform well under emergency work demand;

  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions

  • Employment type: Full-time;

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

  • Modality: Workshop and Field (customer site) activities. Weekly adapted based on the customer's demand;

  • Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours;

  • Available to travel: Required across Brazil neighboring countries (Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Argentina);

  • Report to: Workshop Manager.

title: Instrumentation Engineer
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer to join our Technical Support Team under Global Manufacturing Organization (GM)
The Technical Support Team is a multi-disciplinary team focusing mainly on supporting the technical and business needs of GM Operating facilities.
Your primary role is to handle instrumentation engineering aspects such as designing, developing, installing, managing, and maintaining instruments systems across multiple Downstream facilities. You will also be responsible for providing technical support on high priority systems issues.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Provide technical guidance, support, training, and expertise to plant departments.
Monitor instrumentation systems performance across all downstream departments.
Assess Instrumentation performance and recommend improvements for system optimization.
Develop and maintain lifecycle management activities for instrumentation systems.
Establish auditing guidelines and perform frequent instruments audits.
Lead the development of new strategies and validate the feasibility of improving company productivity.
Ensure manufacturing knowledge is captured in the knowledge repository and continuous improvement is delivered by benchmarking and best practices.
Provide awareness sessions and lead technical exchanges and conferences.
Maintain Instrumentation systems knowledge repository.
Act as a subject matter expert in Instrumentation and contribute to the troubleshooting activities.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
You will have a minimum of 12 years' experience in refining /oil and gas plants /petrochemical industries.
You will be proficient in the codes and standards in the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
You will have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
You will be Familiar with field instrument types and applications.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

title: Delivery Operations Analyst
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You'll Work With


The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You'll Solve


As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.
  • Quality & Timeliness: Ensure all data is extracted in a timely manner and meets our high standards for data quality.
  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for protecting the organization's information systems and digital assets by developing, implementing, and maintaining technical security controls. This role includes conducting security assessments, monitoring systems for vulnerabilities or intrusions, and ensuring that the organization's IT environment remains compliant with industry and regulatory standards such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. The engineer also plays a critical role in incident detection, response, and prevention.
Supervisory Authority
NONE
Nature And Scope
Operating in a dynamic threat landscape, the Cybersecurity Engineer reports to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity and works with other IT, compliance, and business stakeholders. Although not a supervisory role, the Cybersecurity Engineer may guide junior staff or external contractors and lead technical implementation efforts on security-related projects. The role demands staying up to date on emerging threats, tools, and best practices, and proactively evolving the organization's defenses accordingly.
This position is both hands-on and strategic, requiring expertise in secure system design, threat intelligence, monitoring tools, and risk mitigation. It encompasses environments spanning on-premises data centers, hybrid infrastructures, and public clouds (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Principal Accountabilities
Conduct vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security configuration reviews.
Evaluate system and application hardening measures using CIS benchmarks and STIGs.
Monitor networks and endpoints using tools like SIEM, EDR, and IDS/IPS (e.g., CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
Analyze security events and logs to detect, triage, and respond to threats.
Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools, including:
Firewalls
Network Access Control (NAC)
Antivirus/Endpoint Protection
DLP, CASB, and vulnerability management platforms
Develop and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and operating procedures.
Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external frameworks such as NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI DSS.
Develop and deliver training on phishing, password hygiene, and secure computing practices.
Support tabletop exercises and simulation drills to test security readiness.
Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security into system architecture.
Participate in project reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the system development lifecycle.
Core Competencies
Experience in the following:
Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RAIDUS\NPS, CAs
Bare metal servers and data center configurations
Falcon Crowdstrike
Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
Hybrid cloud integrations
Authentication protocols
Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE
Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations
Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security
Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management
Deep understanding of encryption, PKI, authentication, secure networking, and operating system security across Linux and Windows environments.
Proficient in analyzing logs, threat intelligence, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) to drive timely threat mitigation.
Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Methodical and responsive approach to detecting, responding to, and remediating security incidents.
Works cross-functionally with IT, audit, compliance, and legal to promote enterprise-wide security awareness and enforcement.
Careful review of systems, code, and configurations to identify small changes that may indicate large risks.
Able to shift priorities rapidly in response to new vulnerabilities, threat campaigns, or business requirements.
Minimum Requirements
A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in computer science/ Information Technology with a security concentration. A master's degree in business administration is highly desirable. Must have 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a security engineering role. One or more industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer Associate is required or strongly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate hands-on expertise in network and application security architecture, cloud security controls across platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP, identity and access management (including IAM, SSO, and MFA), and security monitoring tools such as SIEM, SOAR, and EDR. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and secure DevSecOps practices is essential. A solid understanding of key regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements—including GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA, and FISMA—is also required. In addition to technical capabilities, the candidate should possess strong collaboration and critical thinking skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The Office of Undergraduate Studies (OUS), an established unit within the Office of the Provost, operates with goals to meet and exceed retention, persistence, graduation, career, and post-graduate outcomes. OUS comprises three major units: The Academic Center for Excellence, the Center for Career & Professional Success, and the Office of General Education. Collectively, OUS units provide transformative offerings through three major functions: academic excellence support, academic and career exploration, and career development.
Basic Function
Provide career coaching, guide self-discovery through workshops and experiential learning opportunities, and assist students and recent alumni with resume, interview, job/internship search, and overall career preparation.
Nature And Scope
Reporting to the Director, Center for Career and Professional Success, the Career Coach serves as a key supporter in the vocational journey of students and recent alumni. Provides advice and coaching as well as facilitating experiential learning opportunities, supports job and internship search, and champions overall career development. Must also have effective interpersonal skills, including verbal and written communications, training abilities, and customer service skills and experience.
Principal Accountabilities
Provide individual and group career coaching to undergraduate students and new alumni related to major and career exploration, internship and job search, professional development, graduate school planning, employer and alumni engagement.
Conduct resume/cover letter critiques and job-search strategies and provide guidance regarding application procedures.
Coach and advise students on available tools, resources, services, and employment platforms.
Create and facilitate engaging and informative workshops, events, and programs.
Administer and interpret career assessment instruments (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator, Strengths, Focus 2).
Provide liaison and consultative services to departments, faculty, staff, specific student populations, and student organizations.
Maintain case notes that track client progress, assessment results, and counseling goals.
May teach Career Development courses.
Engage and maintain relationships with employers to aid in student recruitment and professional development activities.
Assist in the management of the VMock platform, including troubleshooting, training staff/students, and tracking data.
Assist in the management and updating of data for the Handshake platform.
Collaborate with other departments/student services to effectively market internship, full-time, and experiential learning opportunities through outreach and programming.
Provide input into program administration, implementation, and social media presence to engage students.
Participate in staff activities/meetings, annual performance evaluations, and professional development activities, including involvement in regional and national associations.
May supervise undergraduate student workers.
Lead/coordinate special projects or initiatives as assigned.
Represent Career and Professional Success at campus/community functions.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
Excellent customer service orientation
Knowledge of career development and student development theories, research, practices, and recruiting trends
Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and time management skills
Proven presentation, group facilitation, and teaching skills
Innovation and creativity in program development
Extensive ability to collaborate and develop relationships with a wide range of constituents
Supervision and leadership skills
Outcomes assessment, learning outcomes, and evaluation strategies
Outstanding teamwork abilities and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and employers
Development of metrics and methods for continuous improvement of processes, goals, and strategies
Proficiency with and disposition to learn general and industry-specific software such as Handshake, VMock, and Microsoft Office products
MBTI and/or Strength's certification preferred
Ability to work some evening or weekend hours
Thorough understanding of the benefits of workplace diversity and the career-related developmental needs of Black and underrepresented populations.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree. Motivated/enthusiastic work style, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a broad range of students and alumni.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree preferred. Appropriate education and training in a relevant field such as Counseling Psychology, Counselor Education, Student Affairs, Higher Education, or a related discipline, plus two or more years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Somos movimento, criatividade e história. A Inbrands nasceu em 2008 com um propósito claro: construir um ecossistema de marcas que inspiram pessoas e transformam a moda em experiência.
Reunimos em nosso portfólio nomes que atravessam gerações e estilos como Ellus, Richards, VR, Salinas e Tommy Hilfiger – marcas que vestem personalidade, atitude e autenticidade.
Não seguimos tendências. Criamos caminhos. Evoluímos com consistência, estratégia e muito trabalho. Somos apaixonados por construir marcas fortes e negócios sustentáveis, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento das pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.
Nosso DNA
Acreditamos que a moda vai além do vestir — ela conecta histórias, expressa identidades e cria relações verdadeiras.
Nosso propósito é inspirar pessoas através da moda e da experiência de marca, com integridade, atitude e paixão por fazer acontecer. Crescemos valorizando aquilo que nunca sai de moda: gente, essência e verdade.

Temos quase 70 resorts, abertos no verão e no inverno, em 26 países. Oferecemos férias de alto padrão nas montanhas e à beira-mar. Nossos clientes estão em busca de felicidade e liberdade.

De buffets a serviços de pratos, de experiências de cozinha ao vivo a inúmeros eventos festivos, você terá diversas oportunidades para expressar seu know-how e criatividade enquanto se enriquece com todas as nossas particularidades. Suas Tarefas

  • Supervisionar uma equipe de 4 a 6 chefs
  • Gerenciar pedidos e estoques para a seção (pratos quentes, frios, café da manhã)

  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços, o cumprimento das normas de saúde e segurança do Club Med, bem como a manutenção dos bens do resort
  • Unir e motivar sua equipe em torno dos objetivos definidos e apoiá-los em seu desenvolvimento
  • Integrar nossas equipes também é uma oportunidade única de viver e trabalhar com pessoas de todas as origens, nos lugares mais "Instagramáveis" do mundo
  • Você criará uma experiência valiosa para seu currículo, em uma empresa que acompanha e treina você continuamente para ajudá-lo a se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmo

Ao se tornar um G.O Chef de Partie, você poderá usufruir das infraestruturas e atividades oferecidas pelo Club Med. E se quiser, você pode até subir ao palco para mostrar seus talentos

title: Field Medical Advisor
description:
Our client is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company's R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.
The Opportunity:
Syneos Health is seeking two Field Medical Advisors (FMAs) to support clinical trial programs in oncology across Latin America. This recruitment requires one FMA to be a resident of Brazil and one FMA to be a resident of Argentina.
This role will be instrumental in driving the scientific excellence, clinical insight, and medical strategy supporting our oncology pipeline and marketed products. The Medical Advisor ensures scientific integrity and alignment with global and LATAM medical affairs objectives. The position will require close collaboration with cross-functional partners including clinical development, regulatory, commercial, HEOR, market access, and field medical teams.
Responsibilities:
Develop and implement the Medical Affairs strategy and tactical plans for assigned products and therapeutic areas, tailored to the local LATAM market (Argentina or Brazil).
Establish and maintain trusted scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and healthcare professionals across LATAM countries (Argentina or Brazil).
Provide medical oversight and scientific input to cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
Contribute to medical input in promotional and non-promotional materials, internal training, and advisory boards.
Plan and execute national medical meetings, symposia, and congress participation to enhance scientific visibility.
Support investigator-initiated trials and local clinical research activities in collaboration with global and regional teams.
Monitor the competitive and scientific landscape to inform internal strategy and provide actionable medical insights.
Partner with HEOR and market access to develop real-world evidence and outcomes research projects.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (local regulations in LATAM)
Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and CROs, including site selection, Site Initiation Visits, and investigator engagement
Provide scientific review to ensure medical accuracy in materials developed by cross functional teams, including non promotional content and internal scientific training.
Requirements:
Advanced scientific or medical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD) required; oncology experience strongly preferred.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related functions in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Strong understanding of oncology clinical development, evidence generation, and treatment landscape.
Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical data effectively.
Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, academic researchers, and medical societies.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills.
Fluency in Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional, and multicultural environment.
Willingness to travel nationally and internationally (up to 70%).
Preferred Education, Experience and Skills:
Prior experience supporting oncology product launches or lifecycle management activities.
Strong network within the corresponding country oncology community" (Argentina or Brazil)
Experience leading or supporting investigator-initiated or real-world evidence studies.
Knowledge of the corresponding country healthcare system, reimbursement structures, and compliance requirements (Argentina or Brazil)
Track record in publication planning, congress presentations, and scientific communications.
At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.
Why Syneos Health? Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you're empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients' lives around the world.
Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Executar e manter as atividades operacionais do BCP, conforme metodologias e diretrizes definidas pela liderança.

Acompanhar e atualizar planos de ação decorrentes de testes, incidentes ou avaliações de maturidade.
Atualizar e manter indicadores de desempenho e maturidade do BCP, assegurando dados confiáveis para consolidação.
Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e executivos, organizando informações para apresentação à liderança.
Controles Internos
Apoiar a manutenção do ambiente de Controles Internos, conforme framework adotado (ex.: COSO).
Atuar de forma colaborativa e instrutiva com assuntos técnicos em conjunto com as áreas de negócios para estrutura de controles internos e/ou soluções de problemáticas de processos.

Execução do escopo de Controles Internos:
Entrevistas com os pontos focais das áreas de negócio;
Desenho do processo em formato de fluxogramas;
Estruturar e avaliar riscos e fatores de riscos em matriz em conjunto com os donos de risco;
Listar controles identificados em matriz em conjunto com os donos de controle;
Estruturar Walkthrough de Controle / Avaliação do Desenho com explicação e evidências claras;
Planejar e executar fase de teste de controle considerando solicitação e análise de evidências;
Alinhar os resultados dos testes com os donos de controle;
Apoiar a área de negócio com a criação de planos de ação referente as recomendações.

Consolidar dados e informações para relatórios gerenciais, apoiando a tomada de decisão da liderança.

Apoiar em atividades referentes ao mapa de riscos corporativos, incluindo: (i) Classificação, (ii) Avaliação de impacto, probabilidade, (iii) Controles mitigadores e (iv) Planos de Ação.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
IT Support Technician

  • Located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday - Friday

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The IT Support Technician provides basic technical support to the Brazil business unit. This role focuses on assisting with day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting user access, and maintaining system functionality. The position works under the guidance of senior IT staff and collaborates with local teams to ensure smooth IT operations. The role reports directly to the Director of IT and maintains a functional reporting line to the Operations Manager.

Tasks:

  1. Perform basic troubleshooting with the ability to resolve common hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
  2. Provide user support by assisting with password resets, account lockouts, and VPN connectivity issues.
  3. Monitor system performance and report issues to senior IT staff and via applicable Remedy Ticket Systems.
  4. Assist with software installations and updates of standard applications under supervision.
  5. Provide inventory & setup by preparing new workstations and ensuring proper configuration.
  6. Maintain records of support requests and resolutions.
  7. Perform simple maintenance tasks like cleaning equipment and checking cables.

Skills:

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP addresses, Wi-Fi setup).
  • Ability to follow instructions and escalate complex issues.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not include supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a professional office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones. Additionally, the role may occasionally require interaction with enterprise-grade IT and infrastructure systems such as firewalls, network switches, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and both copper and fiber optic network cabling under the supervision of Senior IT staff.

Physical Demands:

This is an active, hands-on role that requires the IT Support Technician to spend a significant portion of the day standing and moving. The position may involve short bursts of physically demanding activity, such as lifting and relocating computer equipment or navigating stairs. On occasion, tasks may require working in confined or elevated spaces, including under raised computer room floors or above drop ceilings.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time role, and as such, the IT Support Technician is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Core working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours, including occasional night, weekend, and holiday work, may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and support operational needs.

Travel:

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate. Travel will mostly be within the Rio De Janeiro area visiting client and 3
rd
 party sites to service our equipment located at those sites.

Required Education and Experience

  • Certificate of Completion of Secondary Education
  • IT-related coursework, professional training, or industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience of up to 2 years in IT support, system administration, or networking (including internships or technical school experience).
  • Working proficiency in English.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

None required.

Other Duties:

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employer for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Analista de Departamento Pessoal
description:
Vaga na Polen para Analista de Departamento Pessoal
A Polen é uma startup que nasceu com a ambição de revolucionar a maneira como as empresas e a sociedade lidam com seus resíduos. Utilizamos tecnologia para tornar fácil e lucrativa a adesão da economia circular por empresas de todos os setores.

Essa vaga integra nosso time de Pessoas, com foco na gestão de rotinas de DP de nossas filiais operacionais no projeto Hive. Você será o elo entre nossas filiais e a matriz, garantindo que todos os processos de Departamento Pessoal funcionem de forma fluida e dentro da legislação.

Quem é você

  • Experiência com rotinas de Departamento Pessoal (admissão, desligamento, folha de pagamento)
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista (CLT, eSocial)
  • Excel intermediário/avançado
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e com boa comunicação
  • Capacidade de criar processos e organizar fluxos de trabalho

Sua rotina vai envolver

  • Consolidar e validar informações trabalhistas que os gerentes administrativos de cada filial vão coletar (ponto, atestados, documentos, etc.)
  • Criar, organizar e padronizar os fluxos de envio de informações entre filiais e matriz
  • Processar a documentação no sistema da contabilidade (Onvio) e garantir cumprimento de prazos do eSocial
  • Ser o ponto de referência para os gerentes das filiais em dúvidas sobre rotinas de RH e DP
  • Conduzir processos de admissão e desligamento - contato direto com colaboradores para documentação e orientações
  • Fazer interface com o escritório de contabilidade para garantir que as informações estejam corretas e no prazo
  • Coordenar exames ocupacionais - definir fornecedores, agendar e controlar ASOs das filiais
  • Manter registro de informações organizado - arquivos, documentos, controles, cadastros atualizados

O que vai fazer você sair na frente

  • Experiência com gestão de múltiplas unidades/filiais
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de contabilidade (Onvio é um plus)
  • Vivência em empresas em estruturação
  • Experiência em empresas do setor ambiental (coleta, gestão ou processamento de resíduos)

O que não vai fazer com que você fique pra trás
Não cumprir 100% dos requisitos da vaga, acreditamos e contamos com sua capacidade e disponibilidade de aprender sempre.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical depth, collaboration, and systems thinking shape the future of subsea developments?
Would you bring the curiosity, adaptability, and engineering mindset needed to solve complex challenges in early-phase offshore projects?
Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team
Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create subsea systems the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea products and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best
As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, where you will give support to projects and support technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects. You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams, interacting with Customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Executing System design to proposals and projects.
  • Reporting of progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Defining system layout from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as Trees, Controls, Wellhead connections, Manifolds, and Flowlines.
  • Acting or supporting the study manager with technical interface, change control, technical variations, and general delivery of the scope.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts.
  • Liaising with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are being met and ensuring they are aware of the data input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Supporting the OFE sales and commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement or invitations to tender.
  • Assisting in the preparation of proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker.

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a MSc or BSc degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Controls Engineering or equivalent as required with extensive experience in a similar role.
  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.
  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.
  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: Field architecture / Flow assurance / System Analysis / Interface Management / Requirement Management / Process engineering / Subsea Production Systems / Risers, flowlines and pipelines / Control systems / Constructability and installation.
  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Be available to travel internationally for project needs and for short term assignments.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

Missão do cargo:
Conduzir o desenvolvimento e a implementação de estratégias avançadas para otimizar a recuperação de óleo e gás, assegurando a eficiência no desenvolvimento de reservatórios e fornecendo suporte técnico especializado para projetos de alta complexidade e novas oportunidades.

Construir modelos de simulação numérica, ajuste de histórico e elaboração de cenários de previsão de produção buscando otimizar o desenvolvimento dos campos Onshore.

Liderar a elaboração e revisão de entregáveis regulatórios, garantindo o alinhamento técnico e o cumprimento de prazos do BAR (Boletim Anual de Reservas), PAT (Plano Anual de Trabalho), PAP(Plano Anual de Produção) e PD (Plano de Desenvolvimento), além de representar a companhia em demandas técnicas junto à agência.
Atuar como mentor técnico, sendo responsável pela formação de novos talentos na área de reservatórios.
Liderar a avaliação técnica de novos ativos (New Ventures), construindo cenários probabilísticos robustos que fundamentem avaliações econômicas e decisões de investimento (CAPEX/OPEX).

Superior completo em Engenharia de Petróleo ou áreas correlatas.
Inglês Avançado.
Experiência em Gestão de Campos Maduros e estratégias em soluções de problemas para garantir a maximização dos volumes, reservas e taxas de produção; análise de decisão e risco para quantificar incertezas de engenharia.
Conhecimentos sólidos em políticas definidas pela PGN, órgãos públicos ou requeridos nos sistemas de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança para a indústria de óleo e gás.

title: Projetista Estrutural Sênior
description:
A RMO é uma empresa de engenharia, consultoria marítima, vistoria e inspeção que valoriza a excelência técnica, a inovação e a flexibilidade no trabalho. Atuamos com um time dinâmico e comprometido em entregar soluções técnicas de alto desempenho para projetos navais e offshore. Estamos em busca de um Projetista Estrutural Sênior que compartilhe nossa visão e contribua ativamente para nossos projetos desafiadores. A posição é para atuação no Rio de Janeiro, em regime de tempo integral, com contrato permanente.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenvolver projetos estruturais detalhados e de alto nível técnico para aplicações navais e offshore, com foco em fabricação, montagem e instalação;
  • Elaborar, revisar e detalhar desenhos de fabricação (DF), desenhos de montagem (DM), planos estruturais e documentação técnica associada;
  • Realizar modelagem 3D e detalhamento de estruturas metálicas e equipamentos complexos, garantindo compatibilidade com os processos de fabricação.
  • Criar e manter desenhos técnicos utilizando softwares CAD (AutoCAD, SpaceClaim, Rhinoceros 3D, entre outros), assegurando conformidade com normas e especificações técnicas aplicáveis
  • Definir e detalhar materiais, componentes e métodos construtivos, garantindo atendimento aos requisitos estruturais, operacionais e de segurança do projeto;
  • Assegurar que todos os projetos estejam em conformidade com normas técnicas e regulamentações vigentes (ABNT, NBR, ISO, bem como normas e práticas da indústria naval e offshore);
  • Aplicar procedimentos internos, padrões de clientes e boas práticas de engenharia ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de engenharia, fabricação, montagem e operações durante todas as fases do projeto;
  • Realizar levantamentos e delineamentos em campo, coletando dados necessários para o desenvolvimento e ajuste dos projetos;
  • Revisar e atualizar projetos conforme necessário, incorporando alterações solicitadas por engenheiros, clientes ou decorrentes de ajustes em campo;
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto aos clientes e às equipes internas, promovendo comunicação clara, proativa e eficaz ao longo do projeto;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia naval, estrutural e mecânica, garantindo integração e compatibilidade entre disciplinas;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e de coordenação, contribuindo com soluções construtivas e melhorias no desenvolvimento dos projetos;
  • Controlar, organizar e manter atualizada a documentação técnica dos projetos, assegurando rastreabilidade e controle de revisões;
  • Executar todas as atividades em conformidade com os processos internos de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (QSMS);
  • Contribuir para soluções construtivas que otimizem prazo, custo e segurança operacional;
  • Identificar e resolver, de forma proativa, eventuais problemas técnicos durante a execução dos projetos, adotando uma abordagem prática e orientada à solução.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação técnica ou tecnológica em Desenho Técnico, Mecânica, Estruturas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em projetos estruturais aplicados à construção, modificação e reparo de estruturas navais e offshore;
  • Disponibilidade para acompanhamento de atividades em campo (porto, fábrica, estaleiro e offshore) e para realização de viagens, conforme a necessidade do projeto.
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado à identificação e solução de problemas técnicos;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos, bem como dos requisitos de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (QSMS);
  • Fluência em português e conhecimento básico de inglês para comunicação oral e escrita em contexto técnico.

Qualificações Diferenciais

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na elaboração de desenhos estruturais aplicados à fabricação de estruturas metálicas, bem como à modificação e ao reparo de estruturas navais e offshore;
  • Experiência com normas aplicáveis ao setor de projetos de engenharia Naval e offshore (API, DNV, ABS, etc.) e regulamentos brasileiros aplicáveis ao setor offshore.

Benefícios e Diferenciais da RMO

  • Regime de trabalho flexível com possibilidade de "home office";
  • Ambiente colaborativo e foco no desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Participação em projetos de destaque no setor naval e offshore.

Processo Seletivo:

  • Análise Curricular, com foco na experiência em projetos navais e offshore;
  • Entrevista Técnica, avaliando a vivência prática em estruturas offshore e navais;
  • Avaliação Técnica Específica, voltada à comprovação de conhecimento em desenhos estruturais, incluindo leitura, detalhamento e solução de problemas construtivos;
  • Entrevista Comportamental, para avaliação de competências interpessoais e aderência ao ambiente industrial e offshore.

O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho, valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor, que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser, inovador e empreendedor, nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integram o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, empenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores. Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho. Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly
Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.
As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.
About The Role
We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.
You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.
Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.
Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.
Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.
Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.
Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.
Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.
Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.
Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.
Requirements (Must-Haves)
5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels
Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs
Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)
Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)
Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale
Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights
Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Nice to Have
Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea
Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research
Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses
Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok
Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist
description:
Customer Success Onboarding Specialist

In-office in Rio de Janeiro

>>> Only resumes in english <<<

About the Project

A leading content creation & marketing platform for K-12 athletic departments, schools, and districts in the U.S., trusted by thousands of customers across all 50 states. One of the key products is interactive touchscreen displays that showcase a school's awards, records, and history.

About the Role

As a Launch Specialist, you will be the first to welcome a newly signed school or athletic department to Touch and guide them through a smooth, high-quality launch. You'll manage multiple customer accounts at different onboarding stages, collect required assets, confirm setup details, and build much of the initial Touch site yourself (pages, content, layouts) to ensure the display is accurate, visually polished, and ready for launch—then support a seamless handoff to Customer Success.

Requirements

  • Ability to effectively manage multiple customer accounts, each at different stages of the onboarding journey;

  • Growth mindset: you're a lifelong learner who's committed to continuous professional growth and development;

  • Solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership; you can identify issues and take appropriate action;

  • Hunger for a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, change is standard, and flexibility is a must;

  • Strong design sense with the ability to create clean, organized, and visually polished Touch sites;

  • Excellent English fluency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication (C1/C2 proficiency preferred);

  • Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be in-office five days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Welcome newly signed schools or athletic departments to Touch and guide customers through a smooth, high-quality launch;

  • Manage a portfolio of partners in different stages of the onboarding journey; collect required assets and confirm setup details;

  • Build much of the initial Touch site: structuring pages, organizing content, configuring layouts, and ensuring accuracy and completeness;

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve questions, remove blockers, and keep launches moving forward on schedule;

  • Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound emails, Zoom meetings, and calls; answer questions and set timelines;

  • Log all activity in Salesforce and ensure a seamless handoff to the Customer Success team after a successful launch.

We offer

  • Mentorship and career growth: Learn directly from experienced B2B SaaS leaders, with a clear path for professional development across a variety of roles in support, sales, and customer success;

  • Ownership and impact: Take responsibility for real outcomes and see your work make a difference for thousands of organizations;

  • Startup experience: Gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-growing SaaS company operates;

  • International opportunity: Work from Brazil, with a global team, selling into the U.S. market;

  • Time off includes ~13 standard, annual US holidays, 15 business days of PTO for the first year, 18 for year two, and 21 for every year after;

  • In-office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (five days per week).
